Widget styles

Source: R/style.R
style.Rd

style() describes how a widget looks and how much space it takes. Only the properties you set are stored, so styles can be layered: a widget's built-in default style is overridden by the style passed to its constructor, and state styles (focus, disabled, ...) are applied on top while the widget is in that state.

Usage

style(
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  min_width = NULL,
  max_width = NULL,
  min_height = NULL,
  max_height = NULL,
  margin = NULL,
  padding = NULL,
  border = NULL,
  border_color = NULL,
  align = NULL,
  valign = NULL,
  wrap = NULL,
  layout = NULL,
  foreground = NULL,
  background = NULL,
  bold = NULL,
  italic = NULL,
  underline = NULL,
  reverse = NULL,
  dim = NULL,
  strike = NULL,
  grid_columns = NULL,
  grid_rows = NULL,
  grid_gap = NULL,
  column_span = NULL,
  row_span = NULL,
  focus = NULL,
  hover = NULL,
  disabled = NULL,
  states = NULL
)

Arguments

width, height

Size, see above.

min_width, max_width, min_height, max_height

Size limits in cells.

margin, padding

Space outside / inside the border. One value (all sides), two values (vertical, horizontal) or four values (top, right, bottom, left).

border

Border type: "none", "ascii", "single", "round", "double", "heavy" or "blank".

border_color

Border colour (defaults to the foreground colour).

align

Horizontal alignment of text, or of children inside a container: "left", "center" or "right".

valign

Vertical alignment: "top", "middle" or "bottom".

wrap

How text that is wider than the widget is wrapped: "none" (clip, the default), "word" or "char". Wrapped text makes "auto" heights grow.

layout

How a container arranges its children: "vertical" or "horizontal".

foreground, background

Text and background colours.

bold, italic, underline, reverse, dim, strike

Text attributes.

grid_columns, grid_rows

Grid tracks for layout = "grid": a number of equal columns, or a vector of sizes such as c("auto", "1fr", 20). Rows default to "auto" and are added as needed.

grid_gap

Space between grid cells: one value, or c(rows, columns).

column_span, row_span

How many grid cells a child occupies.

focus, hover, disabled

Styles applied while the widget has focus, is under the mouse pointer, or is disabled.

states

A named list of styles for other widget states, e.g. list(pressed = style(reverse = TRUE)) for buttons.

Value

An object of class termr_style.

Details

Sizes

width and height accept:

  • a number: a fixed number of cells;

  • "auto": the natural size of the content;

  • "<n>fr": a share of the remaining space (e.g. "1fr", "2fr");

  • "<n>%": a percentage of the parent's content area.

Colours

foreground, background and border_color accept ANSI names ("red", "bright_blue", "grey"), integers 0-255 (xterm palette), hex strings ("#ff8700") and R colour names ("steelblue").

Examples

style(width = 20, padding = c(0, 1), border = "round",
      foreground = "white", background = "blue", bold = TRUE,
      focus = style(background = "bright_blue"))
#> <style width = 20, padding = 0 1 0 1, border = "round", foreground = "white", background = "blue", bold = TRUE, focus = <style background = "bright_blue">>
